server.data: Chat history, comments and modified files are saved in %s
server.noPassword: WARNING: no password set (COLLAB_PASSWORD). Anyone who can reach this port can join.
server.passwordRequired: Refusing to start: set COLLAB_PASSWORD, or listen only on loopback (COLLAB_HOST=127.0.0.1). Put TLS in front before exposing the port (see docs/internet.md).
server.noTLS: WARNING: TLS is off, so the password and all traffic travel in clear text. Fine on a LAN or behind a TLS reverse proxy (see deploy/Caddyfile.example); otherwise set -tls-cert and -tls-key.
server.tlsBoth: both -tls-cert and -tls-key are required to enable TLS
server.stopTray: Stop requested from the notification area
server.txStart: WARNING: cannot start a transaction, %d changes not saved: %v
server.notRoom: WARNING: %s is not a room file, skipped
tray.updateBalloon: Version %s is available. Click the icon to install it.
update.available: Update %s is available. Run with -update to install it.
update.installed: Installed %s. Restart the server to run it.
update.noChecksum: The release has no SHA256SUMS entry for %s.
update.docker: Update %s is available. Rebuild the image: docker compose up -d --build.
